title: List the programs that use the most memory
summary: Show running programs sorted by memory use, keep only those above a size you choose, and show the largest first. Use it to find which program makes the computer slow or runs out of memory.

aliases.text: which process uses most memory linux
filter ps output by memory awk
какая программа съедает больше всего памяти
процессы которые занимают много памяти linux
показать самые прожорливые программы в терминале

steps.explain: ps -e lists all processes. -o picks the columns: process ID, user, RSS (memory in kilobytes) and command. --sort=-rss puts the biggest memory user first, and head keeps 11 lines including the header.
steps.expect: A header line PID USER RSS COMMAND, then the biggest processes. RSS is in kilobytes: 1024 means 1 MB.

steps.explain: Keep only processes that use at least MIN_MB megabytes. $3 is the RSS column in kilobytes; dividing by 1024 converts it to megabytes. NR == 1 keeps the header.
steps.expect: The header and only the processes above the limit. Only the header appears when none is that big.

placeholders.name: MIN_MB
placeholders.description: Lowest memory use to show, in megabytes
